conbody.p: This section describes administrative tasks required to manage the operation of X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
To access Conga Platform documentation, select Platform from the dropdown in the upper right menu. To access Salesforce documentation, select Salesforce from the dropdown menu.

entry.p: This section contains steps to be done by the X-Author for Contracts Advanced administrator. It covers step-by-step instructions on the installation process, admin setting changes, and other custom changes.

The primary audience is any individual working on any aspect of contracts: template administrators, contract managers, contract creators, contract negotiators, contract reviewers, contract approvers, contract facilitators, or the legal team.
Refer to the latest X-Author for Contracts Advanced Release Notes for information on System Requirements and Supported Platforms.
For a comprehensive list of updates to this section for each release, see the topic.
